# Salih Maral — Digital Marketing Expert & Official Google Partner

Salih Maral is a Senior Digital Marketing Specialist and Official Google Partner with 17+ years of hands-on experience in Germany and Europe. Specializing in high-ROAS pay-per-click (PPC) advertising (Google Ads, Meta Ads, YouTube Ads, TikTok Ads), Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Generative Engine Optimization (GEO for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Claude), Server-Side Tracking (sGTM, Meta CAPI), and Online Reputation Management. Serving clients across Germany, Turkey, Europe, and worldwide in German, Turkish, and English.

Ramadan (Zakat, Fitrah, Iftar), Qurbani (Eid al-Adha), Water Wells, and recurring Orphan Sponsorship donation funnels with Server-Side CAPI tracking.

- **YouTube Ads & Video Growth:** Precision audience and country targeting, In-Feed and Shorts discovery ads, organic algorithm acceleration (no fake bot views).

- **Generative Engine Optimization (GEO):** Visibility and citation dominance across ChatGPT Search, Perplexity AI, Claude, and Google AI Overviews.
- **Review & Reputation Management:** Removing unjustified or fake negative reviews on Google Maps and Trustpilot.
